title: Assistant Accountant
description:
CMA is working with a well-established organisation within the services sector, based in Poole, Dorset. The company operates a dynamic environment, undergoing significant transformation as they streamline their business structures. This interim Assistant Accountant role offers an excellent opportunity to gain exposure to busy finance functions and contribute to critical reconciliation and data analysis tasks during a period of change.

What will the Assistant Accountant role involve?

Supporting the finance team in assessing and reconciling historical transactional data within Sage, ensuring accuracy and completeness for upcoming business sales
Analysing customer and supplier invoice data from the past two to three years to identify discrepancies and validate data integrity
Assisting in reconciling monthly and yearly closing processes, providing insights to ensure data readiness for potential sale transactions
Collaborating closely with various finance team members and broader business functions to gather relevant information and ensure consistency
Contributing to the overall data validation process during a period of business transition, helping facilitate a smooth sale process

Suitable Candidate for the Assistant Accountant vacancy:

Experience operating within an accountant or finance assistant capacity, preferably with exposure to transactional data reconciliation
Strong analytical skills with an eye for detail and accuracy
Proficiency in Sage or similar financial systems, with the ability to interpret large datasets effectively
Clear communication skills, capable of liaising with finance colleagues and other business units
Adaptable team player comfortable working in a busy, fast-paced environment and capable of delivering under tight deadlines

Additional benefits and information for the role of Assistant Accountant:

Opportunity to work closely with senior finance leaders on key business transactions
Flexible start times and potential remote working after the initial period
Short-term, project-based engagement with a focus on delivering immediate value
Salary will be dependent on experience
Exposure to a company in transformation, offering insight into transactional finance processes

title: Assistant Accountant
description:
This Assistant Accountant role in Poole offers a chance to support the smooth running of financial operations within the organisation. You'll assist with key accounting tasks and contribute to ensuring accurate financial reporting.

Client Details

This organisation is based in Poole and they need someone who can contribute to the smooth running of their finance team.

Description
- Assist with the preparation of financial reports and statements.
- Accruals and prepayments.
- Manage and reconcile accounts to ensure accuracy.
- Support budgeting and forecasting processes.
- Handle invoice processing and payment schedules.
- Monitor and manage financial transactions.
- Assist in maintaining compliance with financial regulations.
- Provide support during audits and financial reviews.
- Collaborate with teams to improve financial processes.

Profile

A successful Assistant Accountant should have:
- Experience in a similar accounting role previously and be comfortable with prepayments and accruals.
- Strong attention to detail and analytical skills.
- Proficiency in financial software and tools.
- Good knowledge of accounting principles and practices.
- The ability to work effectively in a team setting.
- An organised and proactive approach to task

Job Offer
- Salary up to £29500, dependent on the level of experience.
- Fixed-term contract opportunity for 12 months.
- Based in Poole, within the financial services industry.

title: Credit Controller
description:
Join a well-established Poole-based retail organisation as a Credit Controller. Known for a friendly and dynamic culture, our client prides itself on their commitment to quality and team development. Conveniently located in Poole, Dorset with easy access and a professional but relaxed work environment, this company values punctuality, staff engagement, and continuous learning. This role offers an immediate start, flexible hours in the mornings, and a chance to be part of a reputable retail sector leader.

What will the Credit Controller role involve?
- Managing a portfolio of customer accounts, ensuring timely and accurate processing of sales invoices and receipts, contributing to smooth financial operations
- Engaging with customers via email and phone to facilitate collections and resolve account queries, supporting cash flow targets
- Collaborating with internal teams to ensure billing accuracy and efficient account management, fostering strong stakeholder relationships
- Assisting with basic financial analysis and reporting, helping to optimise collection strategies
- Maintaining meticulous records, adhering to company policies, and supporting continuous process improvement initiatives

Suitable Candidate for the Credit Controller vacancy:
- Proven experience in sales ledger, credit control, or accounts receivable functions, ideally within retail or a similar sector
- Effective communication skills, both written and verbal, with a confident telephone manner
- Strong organisational skills with attention to detail and the ability to prioritise tasks effectively
- Proficient with Excel; training on company-specific software will be provided
- Positive attitude, punctuality, and the desire to learn and develop within a finance role

Additional benefits and information for the role of Credit Controller:
- Flexible working hours in the morning to suit your routinea
- Casual dress code and a friendly, supportive team environment
- Opportunities to gain experience in credit control and finance operations within a thriving retail business
- Salary will be dependent on experience
- Immediate start available for the right candidate

title: Credit Controller
description:
Credit Controller

Job Location: Poole, Dorset

Job Type: Permanent

Salary: Up to £30,000 - £31,000 per annum

Hours: 40 hours per week,Monday - Friday 8.00am - 5.00pm

A long-standing, family-owned business based in Poole are looking to recruit a Credit Controller on permanent contract.

As the Credit Controller, you will be managing customer accounts, collect outstanding debts, and supporting cash-flow performance while delivering excellent customer service.

Key Responsibilities:
- Manage and collect customer debts, prioritising accounts to minimise risk
- Act as main point of contact for customer account, invoice and payment queries
- Hold regular meetings with sales teams to resolve credit issues
- Review and assess creditworthiness of new and existing customers
- Prepare and issue customer statements, overdue reminders and reports
- Manage reconciliations, customer portals and EDI
- Monitor credit limits, credit holds and high-value invoices
- Support month-end invoicing and provide team cover when required

For this role you will have;
- Previous credit control experience
- Strong organisational, analytical and communication skills
- Confident IT user (Excel, Outlook, accounting systems)
- Customer-focused, proactive and resilient
- Ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment

Those who have the right skills and experience, our aim is that you will hear back from us within 24 hours but due to the high number of applications we are receiving at present, we are unable to respond to every application individually so If you do not hear from us within 3 days please assume that your application at this stage has not been successful. title: Sales Ledger
description:
REED Accountancy are keen to support our Poole based SME client who is looking for an immediate Part Time Temp Sales Ledger Clerk to work within a small team. Part Time hours are Monday to Friday 9am - 1pm.

Temporary Sales Ledger Clerk (Part-Time)

Location: Poole - Car Parking Available

Industry: SME

Duration: 3 months ongoing

Start Date: ASAP - Pay Rate £15.00 - £18.00 (umbrella)

Hours: 09:00 - 13:00 - mon - friday

Key Responsibilities

Daily Sales Processing:
- Prepare and print shop sales reports from the previous day for the Managing Director.
- Work through bank statements to allocate and post transactions.
- Process cash reconciliations submitted by branches.
- Invoice Management:
- Once approved by the MD, process and publish invoices.
- Credit Control & Banking:
- Maintain oversight of banking activities.
- Handle credit control tasks, including chasing overdue payments and following up on emails.
- Ad Hoc Support:
- Respond to branch queries (e.g., payment updates, credit limit reviews).
- Answer occasional phone calls politely and direct them to the appropriate team member.

Requirements
- Previous experience in a finance or sales ledger role (ideally 4-5 years, but not essential).
- Strong typing and manual data entry skills.
- Ability to follow procedures accurately.
- Comfortable handling phone calls and providing professional customer service.
- Familiarity with bespoke systems is an advantage (training provided).

title: Temporary Purchase Ledger
description:
An established retail business based in Poole is seeking a Temporary Purchase Ledger Clerk to join their finance team for a six-week period. Known for its collaborative culture and commitment to employee support, the organisation offers a welcoming environment within a growing sector. This role provides an excellent opportunity to gain hands-on experience in purchase ledger processes, working alongside experienced professionals in a supportive setting. The team values efficiency, accuracy, and team cohesion, making it an engaging position for individuals looking to contribute positively during a temporary assignment.

What will the Purchase Ledger Clerk role involve?
- Managing end-to-end purchase ledger processes, including invoice receipt, validation, and coding, ensuring timely and accurate processing
- Contacting suppliers directly to resolve payment or invoice queries efficiently, maintaining strong supplier relationships
- Supporting the finance team with preparation for weekly payment runs and maintaining supplier account records
- Using systems such as Microsoft Dynamics, Excel, and approval platforms to scan, verify, and process invoices with a focus on reducing manual workload
- Collaborating with team members and reporting to the Financial Controller to ensure smooth finance operations during the cover period

Suitable Candidate for the Purchase Ledger Clerk vacancy:
- Proven experience in purchase ledger or similar finance transactional roles, ideally within a fast-paced environment
- Strong attention to detail and ability to handle high volumes of invoice processing accurately
- Good communication skills, capable of liaising effectively with suppliers and internal teams
- Proficient in MS Office, especially Excel, and familiar with finance systems such as Microsoft Dynamics
- Able to start immediately and adapt quickly to team priorities

Additional benefits and information for the role of Purchase Ledger Clerk:
- Hybrid working arrangement, with the option to work from home on Mondays and Fridays
- Supportive, friendly team environment with a focus on collaborative working
- Opportunity to contribute to a vital part of the finance function during a temporary period
- Flexibility in start date to accommodate immediate availability
- Salary will be dependent on experience
